inj.note: The Giants have their bye in Week 8, but Tracy will be required to miss at least four games with his injury, so it appears Singletary and Cam Skattebo (hamstring) will form the backfield duo with Tracy sidelined and Najee Harris recently released. Singletary scored the game-winning touchdown in overtime last Sunday against the Texans, finishing with 55 total yards and the touchdown on eight touches. If Skattebo is healthy, he figures to operate as the lead back, but Singletary showed enough to warrant 6-to-10 touches with upside for more. He's worth picking up in most fantasy leagues.

news.h: Giants place RB Tyrone Tracy Jr. on IR with hamstring injury
news.d: The Giants are placing RB Tyrone Tracy Jr. on injured reserve with a hamstring injury, with Devin Singletary expected to play a bigger role on offense.
